test_model_single_gpu: test a PyTorch model on a single GPU using single_gpu_test with a data loader
test_model_multi_gpu: test a PyTorch model across multiple GPUs using multi_gpu_test with gpu or cpu result collection
collect_results_cpu: collect distributed test results from multiple GPUs to CPU using pickle files in a temp directory
collect_results_gpu: collect distributed test results from multiple GPUs using GPU tensor communication and all_gather
review_test_module: review the test module functions for single and multi GPU model evaluation and result collection
